tidbit: Did you know… one story this hour was carried by two different outlets in the last few hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
OpenAI and Anthropic are clashing over artificial intelligence regulation, with OpenAI favoring broad access while Anthropic pushes for stronger safeguards. Reported by TradingView.
Trump rebrands artificial intelligence as super intelligence in an executive order, with tech CEOs signing a non-binding safety pact. Confirmed by TechCrunch.
Codex built a usable note-taking app from an open-ended prompt, outperforming others in design and testing. Reported by XDA.
Four frontier artificial intelligence models launched in 30 days, with OpenAI canceling GPT-6.1 Astra and pricing and access rules varying by model. Reported by MarkTechPost.
Google uses cookies for authentication, personalization, and cross-device tracking. Reported by KQ2.
Free every hour.
